raw_text: Our own two voices are bishops, and what comes down through them is mostly what a bishop saw and decided [[lpc.limit.ordinary-interior-life]] [[as:paraphrase]]. Pontius and the Acta both tell the death of Cyprian, and they agree on the core but differ on who tied the cloths over his eyes [[lpc.story.the-death-of-cyprian]] [[as:paraphrase]]. We state that difference and do not settle it [[lpc.story.the-death-of-cyprian]] [[as:paraphrase]]. Which outside record do you have in mind?
